title: Toddler and Fluffy Puppy in Garden, 1930s Backyard Snapshot Photo
description: A charming outdoor snapshot capturing a smiling toddler sitting outside on a stone rockery border in a garden alongside a small, fluffy puppy. The child is dressed in a light-colored knit summer romper or sunsuit with white shoes, casually resting one hand behind their head. Dense garden bushes, a flower bed, and a clapboard wooden house wall with a window are visible behind them. The back of the print features dark album paper residue on the corners and a stamped photo-finishing mark reading '36 D'.
